dedupeResult: The active pull-request file inventory, current run data, recent run history and repository commit history were checked for the station names, domains and canonical submission URLs. No existing RTRFM or PBS 106.7FM submission record was identified. Each station was added once, with its authorized digital, protected-email and optional physical routes consolidated into one opportunity to prevent duplicate outreach.
emailVerificationLevel: RTRFM publishes purpose-bound music-submission and Music Director email links through Cloudflare protection. They were recorded only as protected contact boundaries and were not decoded, guessed, stored or used. PBS routes submissions through its first-party form and publishes no plaintext submission mailbox on that page. Email verification was therefore limited to official publication and stated purpose; no SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probe was performed.
safety: No email, form, CAPTCHA, package or music submission was sent; no anti-spam field was touched; no track, stream, download, attachment, biography, press material, metadata, rights declaration, consent or personal data was supplied; no login, CAPTCHA, email-protection, anti-bot, payment or platform restriction was entered or bypassed; no contact was guessed; and no SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probing was performed.
